core_obligations: Verify the inertia isomorphism and finiteness

difficulty_reason: Verifies the inertia isomorphism I_{X'} = X' x_X I_X from the aut-iso-unramified lemma, runs the etale-local finite-inertia covering to reduce to well-nigh-affine charts, obtains the cartesian diagrams and etaleness of M_i -> M', M from the keel-mori proof, and proves separatedness of M' -> M by the universally-closed argument on the diagonal square (top arrow uc, verticals universal homeomorphisms) whence an etale monomorphism that is uc is a closed immersion.
